notes.title: Version Update Ver. 1.04
notes.notes:
Fix: Corrected bugs related to certain languages and typos.
Fix: Resolved an issue where the floor count in multiplayer mode was incorrect.
Fix: Attempted to fix a rare bug where the game would freeze during level completion.

notes.title: Version Update Ver. 1.03b
notes.notes:
- Fix: Resolved a bug in story 3-2 and 4-2 where players needed to press an extra button after the dialogue ended to transition to the next scene.

- Fix: Fixed the issue where direction indicators for the scrolling platforms in the Piston Fortress were not displayed correctly.

notes.title: Version Update Ver. 1.03
notes.notes:
- Optimization: Frostia now recovers a portion of SP when consuming "Ice Crystals," based on difficulty level.
- Fix: Corrected errors in English story dialogue.
- Fix: Fixed several typos in Chinese text.

notes.title: Version Update Ver. 1.02e
notes.notes: - Optimization: Added character trait explanations for Ryu and Dixie Tini in transition descriptions.

notes.title: Version 1.02d Update
notes.notes:
- Fixed a bug where characters were not properly removed from the game when falling.

- Fixed a bug in the tutorial stage that could cause numerous errors when a character died.

notes.title: Version 1.02c Update
notes.notes:
- Optimization: Improved the Battle mode UI for easier recognition.
- Optimization: Added corresponding Player numbers above characters' heads in Battle mode.
- Fixed: A bug that allowed "Hurried Gentleman" and "Happy Gentleman" to be used in Battle mode. (Battle mode only supports "Skilled Gentleman" and "Gentleman Connoisseur" difficulties.)

notes.title: Version 1.02b Update
notes.notes: - Fixed bugs in certain multiplayer stages causing display errors and incorrect player deaths.

notes.title: Version 1.02a & 1.02c Update
notes.notes:
- Reduced the sense of repetitive grinding in the second playthrough and beyond.

Now, when playing through the second playthrough with a new character, you only need to challenge boss-level stages to unlock related content.

We sincerely apologize to players currently midway through their second playthrough, but we believe that this change will significantly reduce the sense of tedious grinding while preserving the gameplay experience from previous versions.

As always, thank you so much for your support. We will continue to humbly accept all kinds of feedback, strive to optimize the game, and appreciate your understanding and patience. Using this experience, we aim to deliver even better games in the future!

notes.title: Version Update Ver. 1.01d
notes.notes: Fix: Resolved a bug where the last H scene in Korean was not displayed in Korean.

notes.title: Version Update Ver. 1.01c
notes.notes:
Fix: Corrected some issues with Japanese text.
Fix: Resolved a bug in Live Stream Mode where certain CGs were not being unlocked.
Optimization: Now, even without being defeated, players can unlock defeat-related content upon defeating the boss and achieving victory.

notes.title: Version Update Ver. 1.01a
notes.notes:
Fix: Resolved a bug with "Ryu's" attack skill where the tracking function malfunctioned when shooting from left to right.

Fix: Addressed the issue of garbled text in the English version of story 1-4.

notes.title: Version Update Ver. 1.00J
notes.notes:
Fix: Resolved the bug where the white curtain remained visible in Japanese story 3-4.
Fix: Addressed the issue where "Ryu" did not gain temporary invincibility during the jump animation when using the "Blessing Skill."
Fix: Attempted to resolve the cause of lag in story 3-4.

notes.title: Version Update Ver. 1.00E
notes.notes:
Fix: Resolved an issue where characters in multiplayer mode could not be unlocked.
Players who have already met the conditions just need to restart the game, and the unlock will appear on the title screen!

Fix: Corrected the issue where the values in the top-left corner of the screen for "Dexstiny" were not updating properly.

notes.title: Version Update Ver. 1.00D
notes.notes:
- Fix: Resolved a minor graphical bug in the tutorial story for the live stream mode in Japanese, Korean, and Simplified Chinese.

- Fix: Some unlockable content did not unlock properly when using "Dexstiny" or "Ryu."
Note: Players who already meet the requirements will automatically receive the unlock notification after re-entering the game! No need to retry the stages.

notes.title: "Falling with Ice Phoenix!" Steam Page Now Live!! - An Adult Version of the Classic Game "NS-SHAFT"?!
notes.notes:
https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/36388466/d5c37d081151a92602729d5fa2257db2bc21a451.png

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2685500/_/?utm_source=steampost&utm_campaign=en1

Published by Eternal Alice Studio and developed by F Project, the vertical scrolling action game "Falling with Ice Phoenix!" now has a store page on Steam. Scheduled for release in November 2024, interested players can add it to their wishlist to stay updated!

"Retrieve the Lost Orb: A Stairway Adventure for Adults"

In a distant, otherworldly land, the protagonist Tavaro, piloting his aircraft, suddenly encounters a storm and crashes. The falling aircraft collides with the Crystal Palace at the top of the Sky Tower.

The Sky Tower, located at the center of the continent, is filled with monsters and traps, and the Crystal Palace is the central hub of the Sky Tower. Flovia, the lord of the Crystal Palace, is playing with the frost orb that controls the entire palace when the crash occurs. Due to the collision caused by Tavaro, Flovia accidentally drops the orb to the bottom of the tower, causing the monsters to lose control and rampage.

To help Flovia retrieve the lost orb, Tavaro uses his expertise to guide her in descending techniques, and the two set off together towards the lower levels. Facing trap-filled floors and malevolent monster lords, an adventure full of unknowns and challenges begins...

"Classic Gameplay with New Twists"

Inspired by the famous Japanese mini-game "NS-SHAFT", this vertical scrolling action game incorporates many new elements, including special mechanism floors, hovering techniques, boss attacks, and of course, the "action" elements beloved by old gentlemen!

https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/36388466/2299f4b6b3d4ea5b97999c9422dde29af4a12d45.png

"Exciting and Intense Boss Battles"

Each boss has unique designs and attack methods, with a dazzling array of attacks that will challenge the players' reaction skills!

https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/36388466/9a3728a1db752221d1949ba3531c7e4dbddde78a.png
